exact_identities.statement: SUPPORT(gamma) is exactly the positive support of VISIT_gamma

separations.LOOPS: PATH_COUNT can increase while support cardinality stays fixed.
separations.REPEATED_VISITS: VISIT multiplicity can increase while support cardinality stays fixed.
separations.SUPPORT_NOT_OCCUPANCY: PATH_SUPPORT is not identified with an occupied configuration unless a test explicitly declares that equality.
separations.VISIT_NOT_PACKET_COUNT: VISIT counts occurrences in one path history; PACKET_COUNT(C) counts distinct packets in a separately declared finite occupied configuration C.
